svg.aria-label: About Apheleia — a creative studio for what’s next. A creative technology studio from Tamil Nadu, India: designers, engineers and strategists building digital products that feel effortless — and the systems and automations that keep them that way at scale.

g.text: Apheleia is a creative technology studio from Tamil Nadu,
